In the WEB, “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?” (web:Ezek.26.15). 26:17 embeds the noun "וְנָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ קִינָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִיַּמִּ֑ים הָעִ֣יר הַהֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַיָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְיֹשְׁבֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם לְכָל יוֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ" (oshb:Ezek.26.17), "lamentation/qinah" — but as REPORTED future speech the sea-princes will voice ("they shall take up a qinah over you"), not a command to the prophet; disclosed here as texture, not treated as a lament_qinah onset. 26:18 ends "עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽאִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ךְ וְנִבְהֲל֛וּ הָאִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּיָּ֖ם מִצֵּאתֵֽךְ" (oshb:Ezek.26.18) with NO recognition, utterance, or "I YHWH have spoken" formula in the verse; a SAMEKH follows immediately (single-witness), disclosed as paragraph texture rather than a row-final close, because 26:19 reopens the same messenger formula ("כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה…", oshb:Ezek.26.19) against the SAME 2fs addressee (Tyre), so no addressee-class shift separates 26:15-18 from 26:19-21 and the mark alone does not license a cut here. Close (both sides): 26:21 ends "בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖ךְ וְאֵינֵ֑ךְ וּֽתְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְלֹֽא תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה" (oshb:Ezek.26.21), the utterance-of-the-Lord-YHWH formula, with a SAMEKH immediately after — closing the whole Ezek.26 Tyre-siege chapter before 27:1 opens a fresh strict word-event onset for the qinah proper. Behind this row, 26:14 closed the siege-detail unit on the stacked "I YHWH have spoken" + utterance formulas and a SAMEKH.

P09-001.boundary_rationale: Onset: the verse opens on the hand-of-YHWH idiom immediately followed by a transport verb, oshb:Ezek.37.1 הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַי֮ יַד יְהוָה֒ וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נִי בְר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְנִיחֵ֖נִי בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבִּקְעָ֑ה וְהִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת -- the same onset shape that opens the book's other three long prose visions, and this occurrence is one of only 7 hand-of-YHWH verses in the book. The unit is held as one scene, with the live rival inside it weighed below: the prophet is set down among the bones (37.1-2), questioned and commanded to prophesy twice -- once to the bones, once to the breath/spirit (37.4-6, 37.9), watches the two-stage reanimation (37.7-8, 37.10), and receives the scene's own interpretation as a word to 'son of man' (oshb:Ezek.37.11 וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֵלַי֒ בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה כָּל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛ינוּ וְאָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽנוּ). Close: oshb:Ezek.37.14 stacks three refrain-grade closes in one verse -- the second-person plural recognition variant ('and you will know that I am YHWH', part of a 21-verse 2mp family sweep), the emphatic 'I YHWH have spoken' close (one of 14 book-wide), and the short utterance signature without the divine-name pair (one of only 4 such short forms in the book) -- וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל אַדְמַתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּי אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה, and a pe mark is recorded immediately after this verse (single-witness, informing not deciding). Both sides of the following seam were weighed: oshb:Ezek.37.15 opens with the strict word-event formula וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר, one of 39 verses carrying that strict form, so the close at 37.14 and the fresh onset at 37.15 corroborate each other from both directions. Both faces of that close are top grade; the row is held at medium because a licensed rival stands inside the span, at the 37.10/37.11 seam.
P09-001.strongest_rejected_alternative: A split at the two samekh-marked points inside the scene: after the army stands up at oshb:Ezek.37.10, and after the messenger formula at oshb:Ezek.37.12 (single-witness marks on both). The first is a real and licensed rival: 37.11 opens on a he-said-to-me clause with the son-of-man address (sweep: 93 verses book-wide), a default onset inside a vision, with the samekh standing behind it on 37.10 -- so 37.1-10 would be a complete scene (the question, the command to prophesy, and the army that stands up as its result) and 37.11-14 its interpretation, which carries a messenger formula of its own at 37.12 and a recognition close. It is not taken because 37.1-14 is held as one vision_report unit; the other he-said-to-me verses inside the scene (37.3, 37.4, 37.9) are dialogue turns that leave no scene-complete piece behind them, and the transport at 37.2 would leave a one-verse remainder. That licensed rival is what holds this row at medium rather than high; which of the recognition clauses at 37.6, 37.13 and 37.14 closes the row is held open here.
